documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V2.0: PLA-CF
Bambu PLA CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701A50
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA-CF
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 26 ± 2 MPa, elongation 3.6 ± 0.7 %, bending modulus 2260 ± 180 MPa, bending strength 49 ± 3 MPa) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC, ISO 306, ISO 75) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS anomaly left to review: the Mechanical Properties table has two rows labelled "Impact Strength (X-Y)": the first "23.2 ± 3.7 kJ/m²; 7.6 ± 2.6 kJ/m²(notched)", the second "7.8 ± 0.7 kJ/m²". By the table's pattern the second is probably the Z row, but the TDS does not say so; it is not stored.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2790 ± 120 MPa, Z 2160 ± 90 MPa), melt index (3.7 ± 0.6 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), heat deflection temperature 55 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.42% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (55 to 60 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PLA CF", model "A50-xx", CLP "Not classified", the section 8 carbon-fibre handling warning (gloves when loading, cutting or sanding), and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO/IATA) transport. Its section 8 also reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: bed temperature (TDS 35 - 45 °C on all three bed types vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃ on every plate for PLA-CF, and 35 - 65 °C in its glue table); oven drying temperature (TDS and material-table wiki 55 °C, drying wiki 50-60 °C, PLA wiki 50℃). The product TDS values are kept.

Nozzle guidance: the store page says "Stainless Steel Nozzle NOT Recommended"; both wiki pages say a hardened steel nozzle is required, and the material-table wiki recommends the 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle first for Bambu PLA-CF. The 0.4 mm high-flow nozzle is "Not Recommended" (material-table wiki; PLA wiki: "use of 0.4 mm high-flow nozzles is not recommended"); "not recommended" is not "not compatible", so no relation is written for it.

The TDS "Support Material: Support for PLA" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no relation is written; the store has no product with handle support-for-pla (support-for-pla-petg is a different product).

Marketing prose proves no number: "With a stiffness of 3950 MPa" (store page) matches the TDS bending modulus but is not the source of the value; "Improved Mechanical Properties", "Stabilized Printing Dimension" and "low shrinkage and excellent warping resistance" are not stored as values.

Hex: all 7 store colours have exactly one hex cell, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses. The table prints four codes in lower case (#951e23, #5c9748, #6e88bc, #4d5054); they are stored upper-case for the published_hex CHECK, and each quote keeps the table's own spelling.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/927b92a153514ded9e49b6c40ab85d79.pdf) that was not cached and not read (a compliance test report), so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
The store page also links the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool, which was not cached and not read.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store FAQ (5.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade" and warns of hard microscopic splinters; no registry key holds these.
